description: Take a lease on a specific task by id (for example one that was handed off to you). Use this instead of pull_next_task when you already know the task_id. If the task is assigned to your worker any stale lease held by another worker is released.

task_id.description: Task id, or a pasted Tango task URL.

worker_id.description: Optional. Defaults to the worker bound to this MCP connection (one worker per harness). Must belong to the signed-in user.

name: claim_task
title: Claim a specific task
